room_rent.note: Room rent actuals up to SI on all variants (Prime/Elite/Premier/Platinum/Platinum Infinite)

icu.note: ICU/ICCU actuals up to SI on all variants

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base; optional voluntary 10%/20% co-pay for premium discount

sub_limits.note: Main IPD/room/ICU at actuals up to SI; bariatric capped (₹50k/₹2L); maternity limit per variant

deductible.note: Optional Aggregate Deductible (₹1L–₹10L) available for premium discount; does not reduce SI

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting 2 years across all variants

maternity.note: Inbuilt on Premier/Platinum/Platinum Infinite (24mo for family, 48mo single adult); NOT on Prime/Elite. Baseline variant (Elite) has no maternity

cumulative_bonus.note: Enhanced Cumulative Bonus 50% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100% (200% on Platinum Infinite); reduced on claim. Safeguard add-on: no reduction if claim <= ₹1L

restoration.note: ReInsure Benefit unlimited up to 100% base SI, triggers from first claim, both related & unrelated illnesses; up to 200% on Platinum Infinite / Enhanced ReInsure

ambulance.note: Road ambulance ₹3,000 (Prime/Elite), ₹4,000 (Premier), ₹5,000 (Platinum), at actuals (Platinum Infinite); Air Ambulance up to ₹2L inbuilt

consumables.note: Non-payable/consumable items paid up to SI via inbuilt Claims Shield

global_cover.note: Medical Treatment Abroad inbuilt on Platinum/Platinum Infinite (listed illness, diagnosed in India); NOT on Prime/Elite/Premier baseline

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity & global cover only on higher variants; standard IRDAI exclusions (Excl01-18)

optional_riders.display: Enhanced ReInsure (unlimited 200%), ECB Safeguard, Voluntary co-pay, Aggregate Deductible, Domestic-help indemnity, Additional accident SI, Health Assistance
